title: This is targetted for jammy, but a backport from noble, so the diff vs noble is shown
description: This is targetted for jammy, but a backport from noble, so the diff vs noble is shown

index daf1428..b55161b 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+fwupd (1.9.30-0ubuntu1~22.04.1~ppa1) jammy; urgency=medium

+  * Backport to jammy (LP: #2116176)
